jobs.title: Sr. Analyst, FP&A - Business Intelligence
jobs.description:
The Sr. Analyst, FP&A – Business Intelligence builds and maintains the reporting, dashboards, and data tools that support the Corporate FP&A team and the broader finance organization. This role sits on the FP&A team and is primarily focused on turning financial and operational data into timely, accurate, and usable reporting for management. The role also supports core FP&A activities such as monthly reporting, forecasting, and budgeting as a way to build broader finance experience over time.

This is a good fit for someone with a strong data and reporting background who wants to apply those skills in a finance setting at a multi-site manufacturing company. This position is located in our Corporate office located in Irvine near the John Wayne Airport. It is an onsite position 5 days a week.

**Key Responsibilities**

***Business Intelligence & Reporting (primary focus)***

* Develop, maintain, and improve dashboards and recurring reports in Power BI (or similar) for finance and operations leadership.

* Build and maintain the data connections and queries that feed FP&A reporting, pulling from the ERP, Adaptive Planning, and other enterprise systems.

* Automate recurring reporting processes to reduce manual effort and shorten turnaround times.

* Translate reporting requests from Finance, Operations, and Sales into clear KPIs and visualizations.

* Validate data for accuracy and consistency; reconcile reporting outputs back to the financial statements.

* Maintain documentation of data sources, models, and dashboards.

  

***FP&A Support***

* Assist with monthly reporting packages, including variance analysis and supporting schedules.

* Support the annual budget and periodic forecast processes through data preparation, template maintenance, and consolidation.

* Help maintain and improve financial models and reporting templates in Excel and Adaptive Planning.

* Respond to ad hoc data and analysis requests from the FP&A team and finance leadership.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail and data accuracy.

* Clear communicator who can explain data and findings to non-technical business users.

* Organized and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

* Interest in learning financial planning and analysis; prior FP&A experience is not required.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or a related field; or equivalent experience.

* 2+ years of experience in business intelligence, data analytics, reporting, or a related analytical role.

* Proficiency in SQL for data extraction and analysis.

* Hands-on experience with Power BI, Tableau, or a similar reporting and visualization tool.

* Advanced Excel skills (lookups, pivot tables, structured data handling).

* Basic understanding of financial statements and business performance metrics.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in a manufacturing environment or working with ERP data.

* Experience with Workday Adaptive Planning or another planning tool.

* Familiarity with Python or similar tools for data transformation and automation.

* Exposure to budgeting, forecasting, or financial reporting processes.

  

**ITAR Compliance Notice**

This position requires compliance with the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR). Under ITAR, candidates must be a U.S. citizen, U.S. lawful permanent resident (e.g., "Green Card" holder), asylee, or refugee as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3). Applicants who do not meet this requirement may not be eligible for employment in this position.

**Summit Interconnect is an Equal Opportunity Employer**

We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace where everyone is valued and respected. We provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic.

The Office of Diversion and Reentry (ODR) within Los Angeles Health Services is seeking a HPA III to oversee the Post-Acute Community Transitions (PACT) team, with a primary focus on the Enriched Residential Care (ERC) Program including planning, implementation, and monitoring. The position will support coordinating referrals, client placements and oversee a portfolio of Residential Care Facilities for the Elderly (RCFEs) and Adult Residential Facilities (ARFs), and ensure facility safety, quality of services, and compliance with program requirements. The HPA III will collaborate with hospital social workers, placement teams, facility operators, contracted providers, and County partners to resolve placement barriers, provide technical assistance and training, and promote safe and timely transitions to appropriate residential settings.

Responsibilities include overseeing the development of policies and procedures and client referral system. Provide administrative and technical supervision to Staff Analyst who are responsible for program management. We're looking for an experienced, fashion-driven individual to take ownership of our women's department and help bring it to the next level.

This isn't just another retail position. **We're looking for someone who wants to take the lead, bring fresh ideas, build customer relationships, and help grow our women's fashion business.**

What We're Looking For:

We're searching for someone who is genuinely passionate about women's vintage fashion, trending designer brands, and creating an exceptional shopping experience.

The ideal candidate understands current fashion trends, has a strong eye for buying and merchandising, and knows how to create an inviting retail environment that keeps customers coming back.

**We want someone who can confidently take ownership of our women's department and treat its growth and success as a priority.**

Key Responsibilities

* **Vintage Buying:** Source, evaluate, and purchase desirable women's vintage clothing, trending designer pieces, and sought-after fashion items.
* **Merchandising & Styling:** Create visually appealing displays, organize clothing racks, style mannequins, and maintain an attractive, well-curated women's section.
* **Department Leadership:** Take initiative in managing and growing the women's department through creative ideas, organization, and strong attention to detail.
* **Customer Experience:** Build genuine relationships with shoppers, provide excellent customer service, and create a welcoming environment that encourages repeat visits.
* **Trend Awareness:** Stay informed about emerging fashion trends, popular vintage styles, designer brands, and customer buying preferences.
* **Sales & POS Operations:** Confidently operate a point-of-sale system, process transactions, and assist with daily retail operations.
* **Department Growth:** Work alongside management and ownership to introduce new ideas, attract new customers, and increase sales within the women's department.
* **Store Operations:** Maintain cleanliness, organization, inventory presentation, and assist with general store responsibilities when needed.

Required Qualifications

* **3+ years of retail experience**
* Strong knowledge of women's vintage clothing, trending designer brands, and current fashion styles.
* Experience using a retail point-of-sale (POS) system.
* Excellent customer service and communication skills.
* Dependable, punctual, organized, and self-motivated.
* **Must have weekend availability.**
* Ability to work independently, take initiative, and manage daily responsibilities.
* **Strong attention to detail and a genuine passion for fashion.**

Preferred Qualifications

* **2+ years of visual merchandising experience.**
* Previous experience buying or sourcing vintage and designer clothing.
* Knowledge of resale pricing, brand identification, and fashion market trends.
* Ability to develop creative merchandising concepts that improve the overall shopping experience.

Why Join Timeless Vintage?

We're looking for someone who wants more than just a job. This is an opportunity to have a direct impact on the growth and direction of our women's department.

You'll have the opportunity to showcase your personal style, contribute creative ideas, connect with fashion enthusiasts, and help shape the future of women's fashion at Timeless Vintage.

**If you have a passion for vintage fashion, an eye for designer pieces, and the drive to build something successful, we want to hear from you!**

**Senior Technical Buyer**
==========================

Location: El Segundo, CA  
Work Policy: Onsite  
Level: Level 3  
Hiring Count: 1  
Performance Expectations: Quickly procure complex equipment by understanding the technical requirements provided by Engineering. Develop clear and complete RFXs so suppliers can accurately respond to requests for information, proposals, and quotes. Hold vendors accountable to timelines while working with internal teams to manage scope creep and avoid unnecessary delays and costs.

**Who we are**
--------------

Rangeview is on a mission to build the foundry system that reindustrializes America. We exist to break the legacy manufacturing trap by reinventing critical production for the twenty-first century. Through advanced software, deep automation, breakthroughs in materials science, and modern financing strategies, Rangeview rewrites both the cost curve and the power structure of making metal parts. Here is a video where you can check out our team, office and what we are doing here at Rangeview, Inc.

**What's in it for you**
------------------------

As a Senior Technical Buyer, you will independently lead the sourcing and procurement of complex equipment, outside processes, and other areas of technical scope in support of Rangeview's growing manufacturing operations.

This is not a transactional purchasing role. You will work directly with Engineering, Operations, Quality, Finance, and suppliers to translate technical requirements into clear RFXs, evaluate proposals, identify gaps and risks, negotiate commercial terms, and drive purchases from initial sourcing through delivery and acceptance.

You will be expected to understand the technical details behind what you are buying, ask the right questions when requirements are incomplete, and make sound commercial decisions in a fast-moving manufacturing environment.

* Own assigned category purchases end to end, including sourcing strategy, supplier research, RFXs, technical and commercial bid analysis, negotiation, purchase order execution, and supplier follow-through.
* Develop clear and complete RFXs that enable suppliers to provide accurate technical and commercial proposals.
* Identify omissions, exceptions, inconsistencies, and risks within supplier quotations before purchase order placement.

* Build productive supplier relationships that improve quality, lead time predictability, commercial performance, and continuity over time.

Visio Lending is the nation’s leader in rental home financing. Founded in 2012 in Austin, Texas, Visio enables small- to medium- sized investors to grow their rental home, and vacation rental portfolios. Headquartered in fantastic Austin, Texas, since late 2015, Visio has financed more than $1 billion in Rental360 loans. With more than $400 million in capital onboard, a proven record of investment grade bond issuance on Wall Street, and an outstanding 100+ team, Visio is poised for continued success.

**Why We Love Working at Visio:**

We at Visio are passionate about working together towards our goals to continually push this company forward. We innovate, collaborate, celebrate team successes, and recognize individual accomplishments. At Visio Lending, you’ll work on meaningful initiatives that directly support real estate investors nationwide. We offer a collaborative culture, growth opportunities, and flexibility with remote work options.

**How to Apply?**

To be considered for employment, please submit your application online. While we appreciate all the interest we receive, only candidates selected for phone screening, or an interview will be contacted directly. You will receive application status alerts via email so make sure your email address is accurate.

**Note:** Incomplete applications will not be considered. Unanswered application questions or responses indicating “see resume” will be considered incomplete and you will be removed from consideration.

*Visio Financial Services, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer*

**The Opportunity:**

Visio Lending is seeking a **Pricing & Margin Management Analyst** to play a key role in optimizing pricing, profitability, and growth across our DSCR and non-QM lending business. This is a highly analytical role that sits at the intersection of pricing, capital markets, sales, and finance.

You will analyze market conditions, loan-level data, pricing performance, and competitive intelligence to help determine where we are appropriately priced and where opportunities exist to improve volume and margin. You will make data-driven pricing recommendations, identify margin leakage, build reporting and financial models, and present insights to senior leadership.

This is an opportunity for a highly analytical finance professional who understands mortgage pricing and enjoys turning complex data into actionable business recommendations.

**What You'll Do**

* Pricing & Market Analysis
* + Monitor market factors that influence pricing, including Treasury and swap rates, SOFR, whole-loan buyer bids, securitization spreads, cost of funds, and warehouse carry
  + Analyze rate sheet pricing across LTV, DSCR, FICO, loan size, property type, cash-out, interest-only, prepayment penalty structure, and state
  + Recommend base rate and price-adjuster changes and quantify the expected margin impact
  + Identify pricing opportunities where products may be priced above or below market
* Margin Management
* + Maintain and analyze the company's margin waterfall from rate sheet pricing through realized execution
  + Compare target and realized margins across products, channels, brokers, and account executives
  + Identify sources of margin leakage and recommend pricing, policy, or process improvements
  + Model the potential margin and volume impact of proposed pricing strategies
* Pricing Analytics & Reporting
* + Build and maintain pricing and margin dashboards for leadership using tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Excel
  + Analyze lock volume, pull-through, and fallout by product, pricing tier, and channel
  + Conduct structured pricing analyses and tests to evaluate volume and margin response
  + Analyze and report on broker and channel economics, including points, compensation, and volume mix
* Broker Pricing & Competitive Intelligence
* + Partner with Sales and executive leadership to create and maintain broker pricing tiers based on measurable performance
  + Analyze broker performance using metrics such as pull-through, volume, cycle times, file quality, and loan performance
  + Monitor competitor DSCR and non-QM pricing and product offerings
  + Benchmark Visio's competitive position and use win/loss data and broker feedback to explain changes in volume
* Pricing Governance
* + Produce monthly reporting on concessions, exceptions, pricing trends, and margin impact
  + Document pricing methodology and the rationale behind rate sheet changes
  + Support fair lending monitoring of discretionary pricing
  + Partner with the pricing engine administrator to specify and validate rate sheet changes before release
* FP&A Support
* + Build and maintain financial models supporting budgets, forecasts, and scenario planning that connect pricing and volume assumptions to company financial performance
  + Support monthly close, budgeting, and forecasting through variance analysis
  + Analyze loan-level and financial data for ad hoc requests from Finance and executive leadership
  + Contribute to management reporting, board materials, and investor and warehouse lender reporting
  + Take on other FP&A projects and analysis as asigned based on business needs
* **Available Remote Locations:** **AL, AR, AZ, FL, GA, IL, IN, KS, KY, LA, MI, NC, SC, TX, UT**
* **Salary Range:** $97,000 - $125,000 (Exempt level position)

**What we are looking for**

jobs.title: Meta Ads Media Buyer - Aesthetic Clinics
jobs.description:
**META ADS MEDIA BUYER, AESTHETIC CLINICS (REMOTE, ANYWHERE)**

We're a performance marketing agency that runs done-for-you Meta ads for medspas and aesthetic clinics in the US. We don't sell leads. We sell **prepaid appointments**: patients who saw an ad, booked themselves in, and paid a deposit before they ever reach the clinic's calendar.

We're hiring a media buyer to own results across our client accounts. You'll be judged on one thing: **results.** Where you live doesn't matter. What your accounts produce does.

This starts as a trial. If we're the right fit, it is absolutely a full-time role.

**HOW OUR FUNNEL WORKS**

* **Meta ad.** Video or static, built around one treatment and one offer (for example RF microneedling, body contouring, skin tightening or pigmentation).
* **Landing page.** Built for that one offer. It sells a first session, usually $299 and up, for a treatment that naturally leads into a package.
* **Self-booking.** Every button goes straight to the booking calendar. No lead forms, no setters chasing people.
* **Deposit.** The patient pays to hold their spot. No deposit, no booking.
* **Reminders.** Email and SMS sequences get them to show up.
* **Upsell.** The clinic turns first-session patients into packages, which is where the real revenue is.

We optimize for booked and paid appointments, not cheap leads. The standard: **40+ prepaid appointments per month per clinic on about $3K/month in ad spend**, with cost per appointment ideally under a third of the treatment price.

**WHAT YOU'LL OWN**

* **Every client ad account.** Launching, testing, killing and scaling campaigns, creatives and offers.
* **Client calls.** You run the performance calls with clinic owners. You explain what's working, what isn't and what we're changing, and you take control of the conversation.
* **Tracking.** Making sure every booking and deposit is tracked, so decisions are made on real numbers.

**TEAM CALLS, EVERY TUESDAY AND THURSDAY**

* **Ads Manager Call.** We go through every account. You say what's going right, what's going wrong and the changes you're making.
* **Creatives Call.** You tell our creative designer exactly which creatives you need, for which client and by when.
* **Website Developer Call.** You hand over any edits needed on a client's landing page or booking funnel.

**HOW YOU'RE JUDGED**

* Cost per booked appointment
* Booked appointments per client against the 40-per-month standard
* Show rate
* Revenue the clinic makes from the appointments
* Clients staying with us

**YOU'RE A FIT IF**

* You've personally managed Meta ad spend and can show results with real numbers.
* You've optimized for purchases or bookings, not just leads.
* You can tell a clinic owner bad news clearly and come with the fix.
* You can be on calls during US business hours.
* Medspa, aesthetics or healthcare experience is a big plus.

**PAY:** $3,000 to $4,000 per month to start.

**TO APPLY, ANSWER THESE (applications without answers won't be reviewed):**

* What's the most you've managed in monthly Meta ad spend, and for what kind of business?
* Give one account's real numbers: spend, cost per purchase or booking, and results. What did you change to get there?
* An account's cost per appointment doubled this week and the client is upset. What do you check first, and what do you say on the client call?
* Which US hours can you be on calls, and what's your time zone?

Pay: $3,000.00 - $4,000.00 per month

Work Location: Remote

**Description**
---------------

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Expand your horizons, advance your career, and contribute to a secure future for generations. Northrop Grumman’s Space Sector invites you to bring your pioneering spirit to our collaborative teams. As a Budget Analyst – Level 3 or Level 4 located in either Redondo Beach, CA, or Linthicum, MD, you’ll be a linchpin in missions of paramount importance, defining the art of the possible from day one.

Northrop Grumman Space Systems Rates & Budget team is seeking a Budget Analyst – Level 3 or Level 4 in a Business Management role to provide support to the Manufacturing & Operations (M&O) and Facilities team. This position will be partnered closely with the M&O and Facilities Lead and Managers to achieve Sector Level budget and rates targets. The ideal candidate is self-motivated and has strong interpersonal skills. This role will have frequent interaction with budget owners (Managers and Directors). Excellent oral and written communication skills are essential, along with expertise skills in Excel, strong analytical and organizational capabilities, and confidence interfacing with all levels of management (Managers, Directors, and Technical Staff). The role also requires the ability to collaborate with other budget analysts, fostering teamwork, and engagement.

This position will work a 9/80 schedule, with every other Friday off.

In this job, you will:

* Compiles and reviews budgets for functional or organizational units using actual performance, previous budget figures, forecasts, expense reports, and other data sources to control funds and provide for proper budget administration.
* Indirect expense EAC planning and monitoring, including but not limited to, oversight by pool
* Capital and NCTA budgeting, monitoring, and tracking; coinciding with base analysis and direct labor yield (DLY) analysis
* Monitors implementation of Space Sector target, which may include challenges to meet or exceed performance metrics
* Prepares regular and special-purpose reports
* Maintains historical records
* Analyzes trends
* Establishes cost rates and personnel forecasts
* Recommends and interprets budgetary policies and procedures
* Prepares comparative evaluation of actual costs against budgeted funds, and determines rationale for variances between costs and budget
* Other duties as assigned

This position can be filled at either a Level 3 or Level 4.

**Basic Qualifications for** **Level 3:**

* Bachelor’s degree with 5 years of professional experience – OR – Master’s degree with 3 years of professional experience – OR – PhD with 1 year of professional experience. Will consider an additional 4+ years of experience in lieu of degree.
* No clearance required to start
* Advanced Microsoft Excel Skills
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office suite (PowerPoint and Word)
* Oral and written communication skills
* Strong analytical and organizational skills
* Experience with SAP/S4

**Basic Qualifications for** **Level 4:**

* Bachelor’s degree with 8 years of professional experience – OR – Master’s degree with 6 years of professional experience – OR – PhD with 4 years of professional experience. Will consider an additional 4+ years of experience in lieu of degree.
* No clearance required to start
* Advanced Microsoft Excel Skills
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office suite (PowerPoint and Word)
* Oral and written communication skills
* Strong analytical and organizational skills
* Experience with SAP/S4

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Knowledge of financial reporting and accounting principles
* Knowledge of Compliance and Government regulations (FAR & CAS)
* Demonstrated ability to effectively participate in team projects
* NGRB background or experience a plus

**Curious about all the exciting developments with the Northrop Grumman Space Sector? Click the link below:**

* https://www.northropgrumman.com/space

jobs.description:
Neill Aircraft Company | Long Beach, CA

**About Neill Aircraft**

Since 1956, Neill Aircraft Company has proudly been a family-owned and operated aerospace manufacturing business based in Long Beach, CA. We specialize in working with high-performance materials, including Aluminum, Titanium, Inconel, and Stainless Steel, to deliver exceptional results for our customers. As a woman-owned and family-led company, we believe our employees are the heart of our success. With over 200 employees, we are committed to fostering a workplace that values individual contributions, promotes growth, and drives innovation. Join us for an exciting journey in aerospace manufacturing and make an impact alongside a passionate, skilled team!

**Position Summary**

Neill Aircraft Company is seeking a Buyer to support our Purchasing department. This role is responsible for coordinating the procurement, expediting, and delivery of materials, parts, supplies, and outside processing services to support production schedules and customer commitments. This position works closely with suppliers, and internal departments to monitor order status, resolve purchasing and delivery issues, and ensure materials and outside processing requirements are completed on time.

**Hourly Rate -** $18.50 - $21.00 (Depending on experience)

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Coordinate purchasing activities from initial requirements through delivery, including materials, parts, supplies, and outside processing services.
* Source and evaluate suppliers and outside processing vendors based on cost, quality, delivery, and Company requirements.
* Negotiate pricing and delivery terms and issue purchase orders in accordance with Company procedures.
* Monitor purchase orders, materials, and outside processing schedules to ensure timely completion and delivery.
* Communicate with suppliers and outside processing vendors to obtain order updates, completion dates, and shipping information.
* Coordinate with Production, Inspection, Quality, and Program Coordination to communicate order status and address potential delays.
* Monitor materials and processing requirements against production schedules and follow up on items that may affect production or customer commitments.
* Coordinate tooling requirements related to production and outside processing needs.
* May occasionally travel to outside processing vendors, as needed, to follow up on orders, obtain status updates, and support timely completion of requirements.
* Maintain accurate purchasing records, including purchase orders, amendments, shipping notices, and vendor documentation.
* Work with suppliers and internal departments to resolve purchasing, quality, delivery, and scheduling issues.
* Perform other related duties as assigned.

**Required Competencies:**

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, etc.)
* Strong communication and problem-solving skills
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team
* Attention to detail and ability to meet deadlines
* Ability to understand and track materials, tooling, outside processing, and production schedules
* **Valid driver's license and an acceptable Motor Vehicle Record (MVR), subject to approval by the Company's insurance carrier, for occasional local travel on Company business**

**Education and/or Experience**

* Associate's degree or equivalent from a two-year college or technical school preferred
* Six months to one year of related experience and/or training; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

**What We Offer**

* Medical Insurance - Neill Aircraft covers 70% of the monthly premium for you and eligible dependents.
* Dental Insurance
* Vision Insurance
* Company-Paid Life & AD&D Insurance
* 401(k) Retirement Plan
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Paid Holidays
* Paid Birthday
* Paid Bereavement (Up to 3 days paid)
* Employee Discount Program

**Physical Demands**

* Regularly required to use hands and fingers to handle or feel objects and must
* Must frequently walk, sit, reach, and handle materials
* Ability to lift and/or move up to10 lbs
* Specific vision abilities include close vision and color vision

**Work Environment**

* Occasionally exposed to moving mechanical parts.
* Occasionally expose to fumes or airborne particles and vibration
* Noise level is usually moderate
* Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions

**Additional Requirements**

***This position requires access to U.S. Munitions List (USML) technical data. Hence the individual must be a U.S. Citizen or U.S. Lawful Permanent Resident or otherwise be specifically authorized by a license from the U.S. government to have access to USML technical data.***

We’re dedicated to fostering an environment of respect, fairness, and opportunity for all.

jobs.title: Senior Media Buyer, RoadWarrior
jobs.description:
RoadWarrior is System1's route-planning platform for drivers, field teams and the dispatchers who manage them, sold as a subscription on iOS, Android and the web.

You will own hands-on paid acquisition for RoadWarrior across Google Search, Google App Campaigns, Apple Ads and Meta, on both the mobile and web funnels, and decide how budget moves between them. Success is measured in trials that convert, subscribers still paying at month six, and Teams accounts that add drivers.

  
**This position is an onsite role requiring you to work in our headquarters located at 4235 Redwood Ave. Los Angeles, CA 90066.**

### **What you'll do:**

* Run Google Search end to end for Pro and Teams: keywords, bids, budgets and ad copy.
* Run Meta: prospecting, retargeting and weekly creative tests.
* Run Apple Ads and Google App Campaigns for Pro installs and trials on iOS and Android.
* Optimize to trial start, trial-to-paid and Teams signup, not clicks or installs.
* Build Teams demand: high-intent search, directory listings and dispatcher retargeting.
* Use AI tools daily for copy, visuals and creative analysis.
* Own conversion tracking and keep it reconciled with billing.
* Report weekly on CAC, cohort ROAS and payback by channel, platform and plan.

### **The stack you'll work in:**

* Ad platforms: Google Ads (Search and App Campaigns), Apple Ads, Meta Ads Manager
* Attribution: GA4, Meta CAPI, app-store attribution
* Billing: app-store subscriptions, Stripe
* Analytics and data: Amplitude, Snowflake, Sigma

### **Metrics you'll own:**

* MRR and net new MRR, Pro and Teams
* MAU and paid MAU across app and web
* Cost per trial and CAC per paying subscriber
* Trial-to-paid conversion on the 7-day trial
* Monthly churn and month-3 / month-6 retention
* 6- and 12-month LTV, cohort ROAS and payback period
* Drivers added per Teams account
* Attribution match rate

### **What we're looking for:**

* 3–5 years of paid acquisition for subscription software, app and web.
* Deep hands-on Google Search experience, plus working Meta proficiency.
* Hands-on experience with Apple Ads (formerly Apple Search Ads) and Google App Campaigns (formerly Universal App Campaigns).
* Comfortable with GA4 and conversion tracking.
* A demonstrated AI workflow for media buying and creative.
* Reads cohort retention and LTV curves and makes budget calls from them.
* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications or a related field, or equivalent experience.

### **Nice to have:**

* Selling a per-seat SMB SaaS tier alongside a consumer app.
* RevenueCat, Stripe, Capterra / G2.
* Amplitude, Snowflake or Sigma.
* Familiarity with the gig-delivery, courier or field-service world.
* Would rather fix a broken postback than write a deck about it.

At Sunrun, we’re on a mission to change the way the world interacts with energy, and we’re building a company and brand that puts power at the center of life. To do it, we’re designing a dynamic culture where employee development, well-being, and safety come first. It’s why we’ve become the #1 home solar and battery company in America. We’re unlike any other residential energy company. Our vertically integrated model gives us total control over every part of the energy lifecycle – from sale through installation and beyond – so you can find endless opportunities for growth. Come join a career you can grow in and a culture you can run with.  
  
Who We Are

We’re on a mission to make energy more reliable and affordable for more people. We provide an opportunity with storage and solar to help people access greater energy independence without the big upfront costs. Sunrun is the largest dedicated residential solar and storage company in the country and has a mission to bring stably priced resilient power to the masses.

**Overview**

The Strategic Finance & Analytics (SF&A) team drives strategic and financial decision-making across Sunrun by serving as trusted business advisors who provide insightful analyses. We are seeking a highly motivated individual focused on building and improving scalable processes to support company growth and meeting financial objectives. The Senior Analyst will support the SRM Sales Finance team, delivering financial forecasting, reporting, and analysis for profitable growth. This role requires frequent interaction with Sales leadership and necessitates becoming a trusted thought partner. The role initially supports Sales & Marketing (S&M) with potential transition to other business areas and a pathway to a more senior position within SF&A or Sunrun.

**Responsibilities**

* Assist the Sunrun Managed volume forecast process, including setting deadlines, developing forecasting tools and methodologies, and validating business owner assumptions.
* Coordinate sales financial planning and forecasting, conducting monthly cost reviews with Director/VPs over controllable expenses, by analyses such as:
  + Performing Retail and Field Sales store level profitability and staffing analysis.
  + Supporting the design and implementation of compensation plans for various sales roles.
  + Performing financial reviews and supporting the design of sales promotions.
  + Performing financial analysis of third-party and digital lead vendors.
* Prioritize and address ad hoc financial needs for the S&M business, focusing on sales strategy across various sales and lead channels.
* Develop and maintain standardized reporting tools, including Anaplan models, to provide operational teams with accessible financial data.
* Develop tools using AI to efficiently achieve accurate information sharing and analysis, maximizing time spent on highest impact

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent
* Minimum of 3 years work experience in FP&A, investment banking, equity research, or consulting with a proven track record of success
* Strong analytical skills and effective communication required for this highly cross-functional role.
* Preferred experience with Anaplan or other similar financial planning software.
* Self-starter with a strong work ethic and highly team-oriented.
* Inquisitive, enjoys problem-solving, and focused on driving results.
* Excellent financial modeling and presentation skills
* Adaptability and resilience in a fast-paced environment.

jobs.title: Procurement Analyst (Direct)
jobs.description:
Job Type: Full-Time l Location: San Francisco l Department: AI Infrastructure Supply Chain l Reporting to: Director, Business Operations (S2P) | Work Location Type: #Hybrid
  
  
IREN is a leading AI Cloud Service Provider, delivering large-scale GPU clusters for AI training and inference. IREN’s vertically integrated platform is underpinned by its expansive portfolio of grid-connected land and data centers in renewable-rich regions across the U.S. and Canada.
  
  
The Procurement Analyst (Direct) owns the procure-to-pay cycle for IREN's datacenter and AI infrastructure projects and keeps project spend visible and controlled. The role combines buying the parts that keep existing sites running (transceivers, network cards, cables, replacement hardware - typically, time-sensitive orders, validating, processing invoices against contracts, POs, and approved scope while tracking project budgets, burn rates, and actuals versus forecast. Reporting to the Director, Business Operations (S2P), the analyst is the day-to-day liaison between requestors, project managers, vendors, Procurement, Legal, and Finance, and owns the related records in SAP.
  
  
With 100% renewable energy, we build, own and operate our data centers and take pride in being at the forefront of sustainable solutions for the ever-evolving applications of high performance compute. We believe that human progress is invaluable, but it should be done in the right way - responsibly, sustainably and having a positive impact on the communities we operate in.

  

· Bachelor's degree in supply chain management, Accounting, Finance, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  

* 5+ years of experience across purchasing or procure-to-pay operations, accounts payable or billing, and project cost control; datacenter, critical infrastructure, or large-scale construction exposure preferred.
* Hands-on SAP (or other large-scale ERP) experience: PO entry, vendor onboarding and master data, invoice and SES entry, and invoice exception resolution.
* Working knowledge of the procure-to-pay cycle (RFQs, PO drafting, legal and delegated-authority approvals, three-way match, payment) and of contracts, change orders, and project scope.
* Experience with project cost tracking: budgets, forecasts, variance analysis, burn-rate monitoring, accruals, and cost coding.
* Familiarity with IT and network hardware terminology (transceivers, NICs, optics, cabling) sufficient to run RFQs and coordinate technical review.
* Advanced Excel and strong MS Office skills; experience producing cost, status, and exception reports for Finance and operations.
* Highly detail-oriented and organized, able to manage many concurrent orders, invoices, and projects with urgency, and to communicate clearly with vendors, project managers, executives, and Finance.

  

· Receive and triage parts requests from datacenter technicians, software development, and site teams.
  

* Issue RFQs to approved suppliers for cost and lead time, confirm viability with the requestor, and obtain a formal quote.
* Own the end-to-end procure-to-pay process with internal and external stakeholders.
* Perform SAP entries including vendor onboarding and PO upload for financial approval by Finance.
* Review and validate vendor and contractor invoices against contracts, POs, and approved scope for accuracy and compliance.
* Manage the invoice exceptions process within SAP, resolving blocked, mismatched, underfunded, or misaligned POs and invoices with vendors, project managers, Procurement, and accounts payable; serve as primary contact for vendor billing inquiries.
* Prepare the month-end invoice exceptions report for Finance and weekly summaries of approved SES billing for project controls teams.
* Manage and track project budgets for datacenter construction, development, and technology projects: maintain cost records, monitor actuals versus budget, prepare forecasts, variance analysis, and cost summaries, and act as finance business partner to project stakeholders.
* Monitor burn rates for major contractors, flag potential funding shortfalls to project teams, and work with Procurement on material costs and cash-flow timing.
* Support month-end activities (accruals, cost forecasting, AP reconciliation, financial reporting) and respond to audit and documentation requests related to project spend.
* Identify recurring delays, exceptions, or control gaps across the procure-to-pay and project cost processes and recommend process or SAP improvements.

Other important requirements
  

* Pre-employment screening, including background check and substance testing may be required according to company policies.
* Remote role across US and Canadian operations; requires a reliable home-office setup, flexible work hours across time zones, and occasional travel to data center sites, supplier locations, and team events.

  

The IREN Package
  
At IREN, we offer a highly competitive compensation package that includes base salary, annual performance incentives, and opportunities to build long-term wealth through equity programs. These offerings are part of our broader Total Rewards package, thoughtfully designed to support your health, well-being, and long-term success.
  
Compensation
  

* The expected base salary for this role USD $165,000-$185,000/annum..
  + Actual compensation will be determined based on factors such as experience, qualifications, and market data for the region.
* Total Compensation package may be inclusive of annual incentive bonus, equity (long-term incentive).

**Position Summary:**

MacroHealth is building out its FP&A function and is hiring a Senior Financial Analyst to serve as the analytical and reporting engine of the team. Reporting to the Senior Director, FP&A, this role owns the recurring production layer of financial planning: the monthly and quarterly reporting cycle, the mechanics of the rolling forecast, and the reporting infrastructure that makes both faster and more reliable.

This is a builder role, not a maintenance role. FP&A at MacroHealth is early, which means the person in this seat will help stand up the models, dashboards, and processes rather than inherit a mature system. The right candidate is technically strong in Excel, FP&A planning tools, leverages AI tools like Claude to work more efficiently, comfortable working with imperfect data, and motivated by turning manual reporting into durable, automated infrastructure.

Success in the first year looks like a reporting cycle that runs on schedule without heroics, a forecast model the Senior Director trusts without re-checking, and at least two recurring manual processes retired through automation.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Planning, Forecasting & Business Partnering** (approx. 50%)

* Own the mechanics of the rolling monthly and quarterly forecast, including model maintenance, input collection from budget owners, version control, and actuals loads.

* Refine and maintain the annual operating plan model and support the multi-year strategic plan build.

* Run scenario mechanics against assumptions set by the Senior Director, including growth cases, cost optimization, and hiring pacing.

* Build and maintain cash flow and runway schedules that roll forward without manual rebuild.

* Partner with functional managers and directors on budget ownership, spend tracking, and variance explanations

* Work closely with Accounting and the Controller on close timing, accruals, and the actuals that feed reporting and the forecast

* Translate financial results into plain language for non-finance stakeholders

* Surface emerging risks and opportunities to the Senior Director early rather than at cycle close

**Reporting and Analysis** (approx. 30%)

* Produce the monthly and quarterly financial reporting package, including budget-to-actual variance analysis with written commentary that explains drivers, not just deltas.

* Support the CFO and Senior Director on Board and investor materials, owning the supporting schedules, exhibits and backup with a high bar for data integrity and quality control.

* Calculate and refresh marketplace and recurring revenue metrics, including ARR, churn, retention, CAC, LTV, contribution margin, and cohort analysis.

* Track healthcare marketplace performance indicators such as payer adoption, platform utilization, and savings performance.

* Deliver ad hoc analysis and data requests for Finance and cross-functional stakeholders.

**Systems, Automation and AI** (approx. 20%)

* Build, enhance and maintain FP&A reporting, including executive dashboards and KPI reporting, for all relevant stakeholders, leveraging NetSuite and our FP&A planning tool.

* Use Claude to speed up recurring work such as drafting variance commentary, reconciling data, building and checking model logic, and documenting processes, with the same review standard applied to AI output as your own

* Identify and eliminate manual steps in the close-to-report and forecast cycles through automation, AI-assisted workflows, and better data structure.

* Document processes, metric definitions, and calculation methodology, so reporting is repeatable and auditable.

**Qualifications:**

**Experience**

* 3-5 years in FP&A, corporate finance, investment banking, transaction advisory, or a comparable analytical finance role.

* Exposure to SaaS, healthcare technology, or another recurring revenue environment is a plus. Payer market or healthcare marketplace experience is rare at this level and we don't expect it.

* You've contributed to a recurring reporting package or variance analysis that went to a senior audience, not necessarily owned it end to end.

**Education:**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Analytics, or related field required.

* CPA, CFA, or MBA progress is viewed favorably but not required.

**Technical Skills:**

* Advanced Excel. You can work inside a model you didn't build, trace a formula chain, handle large data sets, and structure a build so the next person can follow it.

* Exposure to an ERP and FP&A planning tools, with NetSuite and spreadsheet-based planning tools being a plus; we'll teach them if you haven't used them.

* Hands-on use of AI tools (Claude or similar) in analytical work is a strong plus, e.g., drafting commentary, checking formulas, speeding up data prep, or automating repetitive steps. Tell us how you've used it. SQL is a plus. Python or VBA is a bonus, not an expectation.

* Some familiarity with subscription or transaction-based revenue models. Cohort analysis is teachable.

**Attributes:**

* High accuracy with strong self-review habits. Catches errors before a reviewer does.

* Comfortable with ambiguity and incomplete data. Asks rather than assumes.

* Strong written communication. Can explain a variance in three sentences.

* Curious about the business, not only the numbers.

* Operates with urgency and follows through without reminders.

**Compensation:**

The expected base salary range for this position is $120,000 to $140,000 USD annually. **JOB TITLE: Senior Budget & Financial Analyst**

**DEPARTMENT: Accounting**

**LOCATION: Fully Remote**

**FSLA STATUS: Exempt, Full-Time**

**REPORTS TO: Director of Financial Planning & Analysis**

**COMPENSATION: $100,000 - $120,000 annually**

**GENERAL PURPOSE OF THE JOB:**

Reporting to the Director of Financial Planning and Analysis with a dotted line to the Executive Director of Finance, this position will have an active role in supporting preparation of financial reporting and analysis, leading the annual budget process, and administering the University's budgeting and planning software, as well as other special projects as assigned. The ability to perform and evaluate comprehensive analysis will be a key requirement for this position, as is a working knowledge of GAAP.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITES:**

* Perform in-depth variance analyses, including key insights and actionable recommendations relating to revenue, compensation, expenses, etc. Gather data and create monthly and periodic ﬁnancial reports.
* Responsible for all aspects of preparation of monthly business unit ﬁnancial reporting process, including calculating, reconciling and maintaining month-end business unit and overhead allocations.
* Act as centralized point of contact for budget managers to lead preparation of annual budget, including the budget calendar, key assumptions, and consolidated budget presentations for leadership. Monitor budget-to-actual performance throughout the ﬁscal year, prepare periodic reforecasts, and process budget transfers and amendments. Manage budgets in Prophix software so users can review their variances and available budget as needed. Answer inquiries from budget managers regarding the Prophix software, reports, and their data. Assist departments in problem-solving.
* Maintain Prophix software including data integrations for ﬁnancials, employees, and students; budget template design and distribution; allocation models; report building; cube maintenance and structure, etc. Ensure data integrity through regular reconciliation of Prophix to the ERP and source systems; manage user access and security; and coordinate system upgrades, testing, and documentation.
* Build dashboards for ﬁnancial key performance indicators and trends. Develop ﬁnancial models, multi-year forecasts, and scenario analyses to support enrollment, compensation, and resource-planning decisions.
* Prepare lead schedules, year-end adjustments, and other information for annual audit. Train budget managers in using various ﬁnancial and budgeting software.
* Contribute to strategic decision-making by providing ﬁnancial insights and recommendations.
* Identify cost reduction opportunities and recommend ﬁnancial goals for each business unit.
* Propose and implement process improvements for the Finance Team.
* Perform other special projects as assigned by the Director of Financial Planning and Analysis.
* Assist the accounting department with special projects.

**COMPETENCIES:**

* Analytical - Synthesizes complex or diverse information; collects and researches data; uses intuition and experience to complement data; designs workﬂows and procedures.
* Design - Demonstrates attention to detail.
* Problem Solving - Identiﬁes and resolves problems promptly; gathers and analyzes information skillfully; develops alternative solutions; works well in group problem-solving situations.
* Project Management - Communicates changes and progress.
* Technical Skills - Assesses own strengths and weaknesses; pursues training and development opportunities; strives to continuously build knowledge and skills; shares expertise with others.
* Customer Service - Manages diﬃcult or emotional customer situations; responds promptly to customer needs; solicits customer feedback to improve service; responds to requests for service and assistance; meets commitments.
* External Working Relationships – Develops and maintains courteous and eﬀective working relationships with clients, vendors and/or any other representatives of external organizations.

**ATTENDANCE:**

Must be punctual and timely in meeting all requirements of performance, including, but not limited to, attendance standards and work deadlines; beginning and ending assignments on time; and scheduled work breaks, where applicable.

**ONSITE RESPONSIBILITIES:**

This position requires **as needed** onsite support and/or attendance to meet the essential functions of the job. Onsite activities may include but are not limited to the following: company events, leadership events, etc.

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

This position has no supervisory responsibilities.

**EDUCATION AND/OR EXPERIENCE:**

* Bachelor's degree (B.A.) from four-year college or university.
* No certificates, licenses, or registrations required

**COMPUTER SKILLS:**

* To perform this job successfully, an individual should have knowledge of: Accounting Software; ERP Systems; Internet Software; Payroll Systems; Microsoft Office Suite software (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Teams); and Electronic Mail Software.
* Skill level with Excel must be considered advanced (XLOOKUP/INDEX-MATCH, pivot tables, Power Query, and financial modeling).
* Experience with Prophix software is preferred.
* Ability to write routine reports and correspondence.

**OTHER SKILLS AND ABILITIES/QUALIFICATIONS:**

* **Three to five years** general accounting experience and financial analysis experience.

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

The Senior Financial Analyst (SFA)— is the consolidation partner for the Ring and Blink Finance team's Hardware Gross Profit reporting. This role works directly with multiple finance managers to bring their inputs together into a single integrated GP view across devices and accessories, online and offline, NA and International. Within that shared model, the SFA owns the inventory reserve calculations outright, serves as the point of contact for system data integrity, and owns the forecasting and MEC calendars that keep both brands' cycles on track.
  
  
Working with limited guidance, the role applies business and financial principles to decision-making, understands the trade-offs behind the numbers, and proactively audits its own work to ensure reporting accuracy during OP1, OP2, 3YF, Quarterly Guidance, the monthly Latest Estimate, and actuals/MEC reviews.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Create and own the forecasting and MEC calendars for the business partners: build the cycle timelines (OP1, OP2, 3YF, Quarterly Guidance, monthly Latest Estimate, and month-end close), publish key dates and input deadlines to the two brand leads and cross-functional partners, and drive the cadence so submissions, reviews, and sign-offs land on time.
* Consolidate Hardware GP across both brands: partner with multiple Finance managers across both brands to aggregate their cycle inputs — net units, net revenue, COGS/BOM, and hardware gross profit — and reconcile them into one integrated view across devices and accessories, NA and International.
* Compile the monthly Latest Estimate (LE): gather and validate the brand leads' submissions against the LE templates and timeline, bridge LE-over-LE and LE-vs-guidance variances, and prepare the review-ready consolidated GP financials each cycle, seeking guidance from team leaders where needed.
* Own the inventory valuation and reserve calculations feeding the consolidated GP position:

Inventory impairment — quantify impairment on at-risk hardware inventory.  
Lower of Cost or Market (LCM) — calculate LCM reserves where carrying cost exceeds net realizable value, applying the methodology agreed with Accounting.  
Excess & Obsolete (E&O) — compute E&O reserves across devices and accessories using EOL timing, demand/forecast coverage, and sell-through assumptions.  
Partner with Accounting on sign-off and carry the reserve positions into the consolidated GP and MEC.  

* Serve as the POC for system data integrity: act as the primary contact for the accuracy and consistency of the Finance data sources that feed consolidation and reserves (e.g., TM1/Vista/Prophecy, TCPU/BOM, DIDM, inventory and demand data) — identifying and correcting data discrepancies, validating flows across systems, and escalating more complex issues to the right owners.
* Support month-end close (MEC) consolidation for Hardware GP across both brands — units, revenue, COGS, promotions/MDF, and the impairment/LCM/E&O reserves — delivering accurate, on-time reporting and auditing for discrepancies.
* Partner with cross-functional teams — Category, Supply Chain, Operations, Accounting, and FinTech — to validate COGS/BOM assumptions, reserve inputs, inventory positions, and system data, and to explain variance drivers.
* Optimize and document the consolidation and reserve processes: improve and automate recurring compilation steps, maintain SOPs and reconciliation logic, and contribute to continuous-improvement efforts that reduce defects.
* Communicate clearly and concisely, both verbally and in writing, adjusting style to the audience with support, and summarizing GP and reserve movements for the brand leads, the Finance team, and business partners.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of applying key financial performance indicators (KPIs) to analyses experience
* 3+ years of creating process improvements with automation and analysis experience
* 3+ years of identifying, leading, and executing opportunities to improve, automate, standardize or simplify finance or business tools and processes experience
* 3+ years of contributing to cross-functional initiatives that drive financial performance and strategy experience
* 3+ years of finance, accounting, or related analytical field experience
* Bachelor's degree in business, finance, accounting, tax, economics, or a related analytical field
* 3+ years of dissecting financial data and identifying patterns that support business strategy experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 4+ years of participating in continuous improvement projects in your team to scale and improve controllership with measurable results experience
* MBA, or CPA
* Experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (examples: SQL, MS Access, Essbase, Cognos) and other financial systems (examples: Oracle, SAP, Lawson, JD Edwards)

**ABOUT ROCKET LAB**

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity's reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

Rocket Lab's Finance team is responsible for all financial transactions for the company, operating as a well-oiled machine to maximize the value of our work. Our Finance team are made up of planners, analysts and accountants, and manage our policies, compliance, and reporting. They're the ones who keep our financial operations in check, always thinking ahead and taking care to meet all of our financial, business, and government obligations. They're attentive, diligent, and meticulous, and are mission-critical to Rocket Lab.

Based onsite at Rocket Lab's global headquarters in Long Beach, CA the Senior Financial Analyst will have the opportunity to support Rocket Lab's manufacturing and supply chain operations, ensuring financial excellence and operational efficiency. In this role, you will work on delivering high-quality financial analysis, forecasting, and reporting while partnering closely with cross-functional teams, including manufacturing, supply chain, engineering, and program teams. To be successful in this role, you must be analytical, detail-oriented, proactive, and motivated by the opportunity to support Rocket Lab's mission and growth trajectory. Join a driven team of pioneers relentlessly tackling challenging projects, delivering on the impossible, and making an impact on the future of space!

**WHAT YOU'LL GET TO DO:**

* Prepare weekly, monthly, and quarterly business reviews for operations and finance leadership, providing clear, KPI-driven insights and recommendations.
* Support quarterly forecasting cycles and the annual operating plan.
* Build and maintain scenario-based financial models supporting production planning, capacity analysis, and cost visibility for strategic decision-making.
* Prepare and deliver comprehensive analysis across cost variance, absorption, production efficiency, inventory performance, and operational KPIs.
* Develop and enhance advanced reporting, analytics, and AI-powered operational intelligence tools to strengthen data governance, improve operational visibility, and enable faster, higher-quality decision-making across manufacturing and supply chain.
* Support month-end close activities, including accruals, cost adjustments, reconciliations, inventory performance, and analysis of financial trends.
* Maintain robust costing, BOM accuracy, and cost-roll processes aligned to financial and operational goals.
* Support capital planning processes, including building business cases, conducting ROI/payback/risk analyses, and monitoring execution for capital investments.

* 5+ years of progressive financial leadership experience in manufacturing, operations, or supply chain environments. And a bachelor's degree or equivalent years of work experience (9+ years of total work experience)
* Experience with cost accounting, inventory management, and operational finance.
* Experience developing or applying AI-enabled tools to automate reporting, improve analytics, or enhance operational decision-making.

**THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE:**

* Exceptional analytical, strategic thinking, and cross-functional partnership skills.
* MBA or CPA certification.
* Experience with Infor LN ERP.
* Experience with Adaptive Planning.

*This position may require prolonged periods of sitting, standing, walking, computer work, and occasional exposure to moderate levels of noise, dust, and fumes in production areas.*

We're on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that's not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other's backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. jobs.description:
Description:

**Who We Are**

John Paul Mitchell Systems (“JPMS”) is recognized worldwide for developing and marketing innovative hair and skin care products since 1980. We’ve been serving the professional beauty industry with salon-quality hair care products, styling tools and professional hair color through our family of brands including Paul Mitchell, MITCH, Awapuhi Wild Ginger, Tea Tree, Paul Mitchell Tools, Neuro, The Demi, Paul Mitchell the Color, Blonde, and Color XG.

We were the first professional hair care company to take a stand against animal testing and continue our strong commitment to giving back, supporting a wide range of philanthropic causes both domestically and internationally. Sustainability has always been a priority, and we are committed to making our company operations climate neutral to preserve the beauty of the world around us.

**Who You Are:**

You are a skilled and enthusiastic, high-performing professional who is passionate about hair care and wants to positively contribute to the growth of our iconic brand as well as to our people first culture.

**About the Role**

The Senior Buyer, Contract Manufacturing is responsible for the end-to-end execution of purchase orders and supply activities across assigned contract manufacturers. The role coordinates and directs day-to-day work across internal partners and external manufacturing contacts to ensure purchase orders, production requirements, delivery commitments, inventory movements, and issue resolution are executed accurately and on time. As a senior individual contributor, this position provides operational leadership, establishes follow-up priorities, monitors execution, and escalates risks to Procurement leadership. The role does not have direct reports or formal performance-management authority unless separately assigned.

**This role works 3 times a week from our Santa Clarita Office.**

**What You will Do**:

* Lead end-to-end purchase order execution across assigned contract manufacturers, including PO creation, confirmation, change management, production tracking, shipment coordination, receipt, and closure.
* Coordinate and direct internal stakeholders and external contract-manufacturer contacts to ensure PO requirements, production schedules, component readiness, documentation, and delivery commitments are understood and executed.
* Establish follow-up priorities, owners, and due dates for open-order actions; monitor completion and escalate missed commitments or unresolved risks.
* Maintain accurate and timely open-order reporting, including current production status, material constraints, delivery dates, quantity changes, and business-impact notes.
* Review MRP recommendations, forecasts, inventory positions, safety stock requirements, and open supply to identify shortages, excess exposure, or timing risks and recommend appropriate purchasing actions.
* Partner with Planning, Quality, R&D, Product Development, Regulatory, Receiving, Finance, and other functions to resolve constraints affecting production, release, shipment, invoice matching, or receipt.
* Monitor contract-manufacturer and supplier performance against delivery, responsiveness, quality, and execution expectations; document service gaps and coordinate corrective follow-up.
* Serve as the first operational escalation point for assigned contract manufacturers, resolving routine issues independently and escalating material supply, quality, commercial, or continuity risks to Procurement leadership.
* Validate PO pricing, quantities, ship-to locations, payment terms, lead times, and supporting documentation before release and throughout the order lifecycle.
* Coordinate PO changes, cancellations, substitutions, transfers, returns, credits, and reconciliation of order, shipment, receipt, and invoice discrepancies.
* Support commercialization, reformulation, artwork, BOM, and technology-transfer activities by tracking purchasing deliverables, dependencies, and readiness dates.
* Analyze purchasing data, supplier performance, lead times, inventory exposure, and cost impacts; prepare recommendations and concise updates for Procurement leadership.
* Maintain accurate supplier, item, pricing, lead-time, and PO data in D365 and related purchasing reports.
* Provide day-to-day guidance, process support, and training to buyers or cross-functional partners on assigned workflows; contribute to SOPs and continuous-improvement initiatives.
* Perform other related responsibilities as assigned.

**Required Qualifications:**

Skills:

* Working knowledge of purchasing, inventory control, MRP, production planning, and contract-manufacturing supply processes.
* Ability to coordinate work across internal and external parties, establish clear ownership and deadlines, and drive timely follow-through without formal authority.
* Strong purchase order management, supplier relationship management, escalation, and issue-resolution skills.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to assess risk and make structured operational decisions.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and production dependencies in a fast-paced environment.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including concise status reporting and escalation of risks, decisions, and required actions.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Outlook, Word, and PowerPoint; experience using an ERP/MRP system.
* Ability to work independently with general direction and exercise sound judgment within established policies and approval levels.

* High school diploma or GED required

Experience:

* Minimum 5 years of purchasing, procurement, supply chain, inventory planning, or buyer experience.
* Demonstrated experience coordinating complex work across suppliers and cross-functional stakeholders

**Preferred Qualifications:**

Skills:

* Experience managing purchase orders and supply execution with contract manufacturers or third-party

jobs.title: Buyer Experience Ombudsman - Irvine, CA
jobs.description:
At Auction.com, we’re transforming real estate. As the nation’s leading online platform for buying and selling residential bank-owned and foreclosure properties, we connect buyers, sellers, and investors with innovative technology. With over $70 billion in assets, our success is driven by a culture of innovation, collaboration, and impact. We go beyond the bid—empowering our people to thrive and shape the future of the industry
  
  
This role sits at the intersection of buyer support, policy interpretation, and distressed real estate auction execution. The ideal candidate brings deep inbound support experience, a track record of working the cases nobody else can, and the judgment and writing ability to build a case file and a recommendation that leadership can act on without rework. The seat carries no direct reports and influences the team through policy expertise, training, and calibration.
  

* Own suspension and appeal intake through the suspensions inbox, confirm receipt to the requestor, and work the Salesforce Case as the system of record from open to close.
* Check each request against the explicit suspension rules in the policy, gather the additional records needed, and contact the buyer by phone first and email second where more information is required.
* Document the complete case file on the Case: the request, the supporting materials, a summary of which rules apply and how, the recommended decision, and the recommended suspension scope.
* Escalate the prepared case file to the Decision Authority with a clear written recommendation. This role does not render the final decision. The Decision Authority confirms or adjusts the recommendation, and does so most often as a straightforward confirmation when the case file is complete and the rules are cleanly applied.
* Work appeals on the same Case, documenting the original case file, the buyer's appeal and any new materials, and a summary of what has changed, then return it to the same Decision Authority for a final decision.
* Communicate suspension and appeal outcomes internally and to the buyer using the applicable notices, update the Case, and close it.
* Implement approved suspensions, managing account-wide and property-specific scopes directly and submitting Tech Tickets to Product for seller-specific suspensions until that becomes self-service.
* Handle the manual review triggered when an account reaches the maximum REO bid deposit tier, and recommend whether to attempt rehabilitation at tier or move to suspension.
* Serve as the recognized subject matter expert on the Buyer Suspension Policy and the Suspension and Appeal SOP, and act as a named policy contributor at each review cycle.
* Take initial escalation of the most difficult buyer situations across registration, deposits, bidding eligibility, account, and payment matters, resolving them directly where they fall inside your authority and preparing a recommendation where they do not.
* Act as the primary Buyer Experience contact for Legal, Compliance, and Asset Management on contested buyer matters.
* De-escalate the most difficult buyers, protecting the buyer relationship through the process wherever the facts allow.
* Train and calibrate the Buyer Experience team on the suspension policy, the appeal process, and escalation handling, working from the training materials maintained by the Sr. Buyer Experience Specialist.
* Read escalation and suspension trends and recommend upstream policy and process fixes to the Senior Director, Call Center.
* Absorb policy changes quickly and push them into the team, working with the Sr. Buyer Experience Specialist so the knowledge base reflects current policy.
* Keep the Buyer Experience Supervisor current on escalation volume, aging, and outcomes. The Supervisor remains accountable for overall escalation resolution across the team."

**Position Summary**

**Parker Hannifin** is a Fortune 250 global leader in motion and control technologies. For more than a century, the company has been enabling engineering breakthroughs that lead to a better tomorrow.

At Parker Aerospace, we develop technologies and innovative solutions that enable reliable, efficient and increasingly sustainable flight for the lifecycle of the aircraft, including aftermarket support. Our passionate people with deep engineering expertise, together with our breadth of differentiated technologies, ensure that we make the extraordinary happen and continue to shape the future of aviation in partnership with our customers.

As a member of our team, you are instrumental in fulfilling our mission: 'Enabling Engineering Breakthroughs that Lead to a Better Tomorrow.' Pursuing a career at Parker presents unlimited opportunities for both professional and personal development. Working with some of the most brilliant minds in the industry, your contributions will be pivotal in developing innovative technologies and products, significantly contributing to Parker’s goal of addressing the world’s most pressing engineering challenges. At Parker, our team members belong, matter and make a difference.

**Military Flight Controls Division** Supporting aircraft worldwide, Parker Aerospace’s Military Flight Controls Division (MFCD) provides primary and secondary flight control systems that make flight possible. Tested, proven and trusted in commercial and military applications for decades, MFCD provides precise position-control actuation solutions for military aircraft across the United States and with foreign partners. The division’s JetPipe® electrohydraulic servovalve (EHSV) technology is used across commercial and military aircraft around the world. Headquartered in Irvine, California, the Military Flight Controls Division is the global leader in fly-by-wire flight control systems and electrohydraulic products and offers the world's most advanced motor design capabilities for flight controls.

**Position Summary:**

The Buyer is responsible for commodities or assignments requiring application of basic purchasing principles, theories and concepts. Additionally, the Buyer may resolve issues in the areas of requisition accuracy and completeness, on-time delivery or supplier payment functioning in a closely supervised environment.

**Essential Functions:**

* Identifies and recommends suppliers by investigating potential suppliers, researching parts, equipment, machinery, services, and materials availability.

Issues purchase orders and agreements that accurately reflect price, schedule, terms, and conditions as negotiated with suppliers. Maintains accurate lead times for assigned commodities.

* Resolves shipment quality discrepancies by mediating supplier/manufacturing issues. Facilitates the resolution of issues by arranging and participating in conferences between suppliers and company personnel.
* Negotiates and settles damage claims, rejections, losses, return of materials, over-shipments, cancellations and engineering changes with suppliers.7. Provides parts, equipment, and materials information by answering questions and requests. Prepares reports by collecting, analyzing, and summarizing information and trends.
* Participates in continuous improvement activities and provides suggestions for cost reduction and improved efficiency.
* Complies with federal, state, and aerospace industry regulations; ensures adherence to requirements and advises management on needed actions. Complies with Government/Commercial Practices Manual (GPM/CPM) policies and procedures.

* 4 year college degree REQUIRED
* Possess analytical and technical skills required to understand business practices and recommend proper automation opportunities.
* Must have intermediate computer skills and be able to understand of electronic processing.
* Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills for effective interface with all internal and external contacts.

* Participation in Annual Incentive Program

jobs.title: Financial Analyst- Real Estate, Land & Leases
jobs.description:
Crusoe is on a mission *to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.

We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.

We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

**About the Role:**

Crusoe is looking for a Financial Analyst, Real Estate, Land & Leases to support the financial due diligence, deal analysis, and lifecycle tracking of land and real estate transactions underpinning Crusoe’s data center campuses. This role works closely with the Director of Real Estate Finance and cross-functional partners to build the models, materials, and tracking tools that keep land and lease decisions moving.

This is a hands-on, detail-oriented role suited to someone early in their finance career who wants exposure to real estate, project finance, and infrastructure deal-making, in a company where land and power access are often the binding constraint on how fast infrastructure gets built. This is a full-time, exempt position.

**What You'll Be Working On:**

* **Due Diligence Support** — Support financial due diligence on prospective land acquisitions, ground leases, and site control agreements, helping evaluate cost basis, tax implications, and site-level economics; assist in gathering and organizing information from Legal, Real Estate, and Power teams on title, easements, zoning, utility access, and environmental factors.
* **Site-Level Financial Modeling** — Build and maintain site-level financial models (acquisition cost, ground lease economics, property tax, incentive/abatement value) to support go/no-go TCO investment decisions.
* **Commercial Structure Support** — Assist in analyzing land purchase agreements, ground leases, option agreements, and related real estate instruments to help ensure terms align with financing strategy; prepare supporting analysis on how land ownership vs. lease structures affect debt sizing and financeability, working alongside Capital Markets/Project Finance teams.
* **Incentives & Abatements** — Help compile materials for negotiating economic development incentives, tax abatements, and PILOT agreements with local and state governments.
* **Lifecycle & Asset Management** — Maintain financial tracking of land/real estate assets across their lifecycle, from acquisition through construction and operations; build and update a portfolio-level view of land and lease obligations (payment schedules, escalators, renewal options, purchase options) for forecasts and reporting.
* **Accounting Support** — Support Accounting on proper treatment of land, leases (ASC 842), and related capital costs.
* **Cross-Functional Coordination** — Act as a day-to-day point of contact for data requests and coordination with Real Estate, Development, Power, Legal, and Project Finance teams.
* **Board & Investor Materials** — Prepare financial analysis and supporting materials for board, investor, and lender due diligence related to real estate holdings and site pipeline.
* **Process Scalability** — Help build and maintain scalable tracking processes and tools as Crusoe’s land portfolio grows.

**What You'll Bring to the Team:**

jobs.description:
